name: Weboworld

sources.title: Weboworld 'Create an Account' registration page (Get Listed Today link)

requirements: General business directory — listings organized by category and city/location (not software-specific)
Account registration required before creating a listing (simple registration process)
Listing supports NAP (Name, Address, Phone) local-SEO fields
preparation: Account email and password for registration
Address (with map integration) — a real or plausible locality, since listings are filed under state/city paths
Website URL and social profile links
workflow: Go to https://weboworld.com/user/register ('Get Listed Today' in the nav) and create an account
Sign in and create a business listing: name, logo, address, phone, email, descriptions, website URL, social links, media, hours
Pick the category (e.g. 'Computer and IT Services' or 'Advertising and Media' for software/consulting) and location
Submit — the site advertises instant approvals
Optionally choose the paid featured-listing option for prominent placement
watchFor: Registration form is JS-rendered — the fetched HTML shows no input fields
Featured listings are a paid upgrade; standard listing is free
Site disclaimer: listings are 'not verified or guaranteed' — low editorial bar, so the link value is mostly NAP/citation
Footer sells 'Your Link Here' sitewide link slots — SEO-link-farm signals; keep expectations modest
Operator is India-based (Pune) with US/India listings mixed — choose location fields honestly
countsAsLive: The business has a public listing page under weboworld.com/listing/<state>/<city>/<category>/<slug> reachable without login
unknowns: Whether free listings carry a dofollow website link (catalog note says follow; unconfirmed)
